# Reports

`PC-001-CROSS-CURVE-CALIBRATION.md` contains the derived identity, the exact calibrator and the remaining arithmetic construction. `PC-001-REVIEW.md` records a read-only second-context review and its material normalization correction; this is not external scholarly acceptance.

`PC-002-RELATIVE-REGULATOR.md` proves the finite-layer precision lemma and Farey-cup formula, records 121 coefficients of both relative series, and specifies the remaining adjoint-period and global-class comparisons.
